title: It's me!
text: Hello! My name is Tom. I am eight. I have a pet. It is a cat. Her name is Kitty. She is white and black. She has two green eyes, a small pink nose and four white paws. She has a long tail. Kitty lives in my house. In the morning, she is in the kitchen. My mum gives her milk. In the afternoon, she is in the living room. She plays with my red ball. I have a blue car too, but Kitty likes the ball. At night, Kitty sleeps in my bedroom. I have three toys in my room: a teddy bear, a car and a ball. Today the weather is sunny and hot. My dad, my sister and I are in the garden. Kitty is there too. She likes the sun. My brother is ten. He likes Kitty very much. We love our cat!
